rule: pool: technical_eligible + CONTENT_MATCHED of Classes2Test preflight, minus every repository of the excluded manifests; per framework (junit4, junit5): candidates sorted by task_id, shuffled with System.Random(seed) (Fisher-Yates), first candidate that meets all conditions is chosen: CUT 30-150 lines, human test 20-120 lines, >= 2 test methods and >= 2 assertions (java-analyzer), no Mockito, no external service or container markers in the test (Spring/Micronaut/Quarkus context, @ExtendWith, @RunWith, injection, Testcontainers, JDBC, SQL, database, HTTP URL, sockets, temporary folders, environment variables, sleeps)
